# 型の規則の総当たり (TestTypeRuleMatrix。`go test ./internal/driver -run TestTypeRuleMatrix -update` で書き直す)

## 大域変数: var v:%T;
u8         ok
i16        ok
bool       ok
E          ok
S          ok
Es         E soa Es is not a value type; use *Es for an element handle, or Es[i]
[4]u8      ok
[]u8       ok
[:u16]u8   ok
*u8        ok
*const u8  ok
*S         ok
*Es        ok
fn(u8):u8  ok
void       E variable v cannot be void

## u8 からの as: function f(x:u8):void { var v = x as %T; }
u8         ok
i16        ok
bool       ok
E          ok
S          E cannot convert u8 to t.S with `as` (use bitcast for bit reinterpretation)
Es         E soa Es is not a value type; use *Es for an element handle, or Es[i]
[4]u8      E cannot convert u8 to [4]u8 with `as` (use bitcast for bit reinterpretation)
[]u8       E cannot convert u8 to []u8 with `as` (use bitcast for bit reinterpretation)
[:u16]u8   E cannot convert u8 to [:u16]u8 with `as` (use bitcast for bit reinterpretation)
*u8        E cannot convert u8 to *u8 with `as` (use bitcast for bit reinterpretation)
*const u8  E cannot convert u8 to *const u8 with `as` (use bitcast for bit reinterpretation)
*S         E cannot convert u8 to *t.S with `as` (use bitcast for bit reinterpretation)
*Es        ok
fn(u8):u8  E cannot convert u8 to fn(u8):u8 with `as` (use bitcast for bit reinterpretation)
void       E cannot convert u8 to void with `as` (use bitcast for bit reinterpretation)

## u8 の代入: function f(x:u8, v:%T):void { v = x; }
u8         ok
i16        ok
bool       ok
E          E assignment to `v`: cannot assign u8 to t.E (not compatible types)
S          E assignment to `v`: cannot assign u8 to t.S (not compatible types)
Es         E soa Es is not a value type; use *Es for an element handle, or Es[i]
[4]u8      E assignment to `v`: cannot assign u8 to [4]u8 (not compatible types)
[]u8       E assignment to `v`: cannot assign u8 to []u8 (not compatible types)
[:u16]u8   E assignment to `v`: cannot assign u8 to [:u16]u8 (not compatible types)
*u8        E assignment to `v`: cannot assign u8 to *u8 (not compatible types)
*const u8  E assignment to `v`: cannot assign u8 to *u8 (not compatible types)
*S         E assignment to `v`: cannot assign u8 to *t.S (not compatible types)
*Es        E assignment to `v`: cannot assign u8 to *t.Es (not compatible types)
fn(u8):u8  E assignment to `v`: cannot assign u8 to fn(u8):u8 (not compatible types)
void       E assignment to `v`: cannot assign u8 to void (not compatible types)

## 加算: function f(a:%T, b:%T):void { var c = a + b; }
u8         ok
i16        ok
bool       ok
E          E cannot apply + to enum t.E (convert with `as` first)
S          E cannot apply + to t.S (struct / array values have only == and !=)
Es         E soa Es is not a value type; use *Es for an element handle, or Es[i]
[4]u8      E cannot apply + to [4]u8 (struct / array values have only == and !=)
[]u8       E cannot apply + to []u8 (struct / array values have only == and !=)
[:u16]u8   E cannot apply + to [:u16]u8 (struct / array values have only == and !=)
*u8        E cannot apply + to a pointer (pointers have p + n, p - n, p - q, comparisons and null checks)
*const u8  E cannot apply + to a pointer (pointers have p + n, p - n, p - q, comparisons and null checks)
*S         E cannot apply + to a pointer (pointers have p + n, p - n, p - q, comparisons and null checks)
*Es        ok
fn(u8):u8  ok
void       ok

## for-each: function f(a:%T):void { for (var x in a) { } }
u8         E cannot iterate over u8 (a for-each needs an array, a slice, a pointer to one of them, or a range `a..b`)
i16        E cannot iterate over i16 (a for-each needs an array, a slice, a pointer to one of them, or a range `a..b`)
bool       E cannot iterate over ubool8 (a for-each needs an array, a slice, a pointer to one of them, or a range `a..b`)
E          E cannot iterate over t.E (a for-each needs an array, a slice, a pointer to one of them, or a range `a..b`)
S          E cannot iterate over t.S (a for-each needs an array, a slice, a pointer to one of them, or a range `a..b`)
Es         E soa Es is not a value type; use *Es for an element handle, or Es[i]
[4]u8      ok
[]u8       ok
[:u16]u8   ok
*u8        E cannot iterate over *u8 (a for-each needs an array, a slice, a pointer to one of them, or a range `a..b`)
*const u8  E cannot iterate over *u8 (a for-each needs an array, a slice, a pointer to one of them, or a range `a..b`)
*S         E cannot iterate over *t.S (a for-each needs an array, a slice, a pointer to one of them, or a range `a..b`)
*Es        E cannot iterate over *t.Es (a for-each needs an array, a slice, a pointer to one of them, or a range `a..b`)
fn(u8):u8  E cannot iterate over fn(u8):u8 (a for-each needs an array, a slice, a pointer to one of them, or a range `a..b`…
void       E cannot iterate over void (a for-each needs an array, a slice, a pointer to one of them, or a range `a..b`)

## printf: function f(a:%T):void { printf(a); }
u8         ok
i16        ok
bool       ok
E          ok
S          E printf cannot print a value of type t.S (strings (*u8 / []u8), integers, bool and enums)
Es         E soa Es is not a value type; use *Es for an element handle, or Es[i]
[4]u8      ok
[]u8       ok
[:u16]u8   E printf cannot print a value of type [:u16]u8 (strings (*u8 / []u8), integers, bool and enums)
*u8        ok
*const u8  ok
*S         E printf cannot print a value of type *t.S (strings (*u8 / []u8), integers, bool and enums)
*Es        E printf cannot print a value of type *t.Es (strings (*u8 / []u8), integers, bool and enums)
fn(u8):u8  E printf cannot print a value of type fn(u8):u8 (strings (*u8 / []u8), integers, bool and enums)
void       E printf cannot print a value of type void (strings (*u8 / []u8), integers, bool and enums)
